Produce a NEW reference-based Godot 2D animation source sheet for the EXACT PURPLE-BROWN HAIRY SPIDER in the TOP LEFT CELL of the supplied TWILIGHT atlas (only that spider, region x0..315 y12..311). Ignore all other atlas creatures. Preserve its thick dark plum/charcoal shaggy hair, tan pointed bristles at joints, round heavy fuzzy plum abdomen, small armored cephalothorax, cluster of tiny red eyes, dark hooked fangs/pedipalps, and EXACTLY EIGHT genuine jointed walking legs attached to the thorax (FOUR on each anatomical side). Pedipalps are short mouth appendages, not substitute legs. Same detailed painted isometric RPG style, restrained original palette, elevated three-quarter camera. No humanoid or ant, no new armor, no fire, no detached limbs. Red eyes stay at the front. The tail/abdomen must stay consistently the same size and connected to the thorax across all phases.
This entire sheet is ONE fixed EAST facing view: head/fangs point SCREEN RIGHT throughout, abdomen to SCREEN LEFT. It is a true right profile with slight fixed elevated view; nearer and far four-leg sets are separately drawn, no direction change, no camera change. EXACTLY SIXTEEN complete independent full-body figures in FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS and FOUR EQUAL ROWS. No additional figures or overlays. Every cell contains exactly one whole spider with all8 legs attached and the same body proportions, same fixed EAST view, and same physical drawing scale. No text or grid labels.
IDLE2: grounded weight breathing through small thorax/leg-root/fang articulation, not a duplicated still. WALK6: six genuinely distinct articulated sequential poses for one grounded crawling stride, alternating two groups of four supporting legs in an arachnid alternating-tetrapod gait: group A consists of anatomical LEFT legs1,3 and RIGHT legs2,4; group B the opposite. Keep at least four real pointed feet contacting ground in each pose; lift the other feet only through knees/joint hinges. Show opposite front-leg and rear-leg lead with consistent leg attachment; body travels as a connected mass with restrained thorax/abdomen tilt, no floating hop or fixed torso with detached bobbing legs. Every pose must be newly articulated, not a global translate/reflect/rotate/copy of a still. The gait should loop naturally at an even cadence.
ATTACK3: rear six legs grounded while front pair and fangs prepare, then connected low thorax and fangs lunge RIGHT with front feet planted/reaching, then leg/neck return recovery. Keep body dimensions and eight legs, never telescope limbs or enlarge the abdomen. HIT2: grounded recoil through crouch/brace then a different compressed knee/abdomen reaction, no red flash painted into the PNG. DEATH3: irreversible collapse at the same scale: front legs buckle/body lowers, then body rolls slightly onto side with legs curling, then completely grounded terminal curled spider. All eight legs remain visibly attached even when curled; no dismemberment, no disappearing body, no jump back to idle.
